pages.title: Карта мира (JourneyMap)
pages.text: We have also supplied with you with a built in map-chip within your Visual Cortex.$(br2)Calling on it with the correct command will visualise a full sized map, which gives you plent of navigational information.$(br2)You can also use it to waypoint important locations.$(br2)Toggle map key: $(item)$(k:journeymap.map_toggle_alt)
